principle: Let the classification field select the EXPECTATION, never the POPULATION. Pin the population to an anchor that is constant across a screen's runtime states, then apply the per-state expectation inside it.

preferred_anchors.use_when: the obligation belongs to every rendered state of the same learner screen
the obligation belongs to one item across its base, popup, viewed and completion states
used_by: TICK_IDENTITY_MISMATCHES and COMPLETION_TICKS_NOT_MATCHING_PATH already resolve items across states; no gap found

preferred_anchors.use_when: child runtime states inherit a visual or control obligation from a parent
used_by: no current gate requires this anchor; retained for future popup trees

preferred_anchors.use_when: every page of a component must retain a shared property
used_by: candidate anchor for the component-main family if Bariah rules that a component visual is a component-wide obligation rather than a screen one

preferred_anchors.use_when: Bariah evidence applies to a fixed set of pages or fields
used_by: SHOT_S01_*, SHOT_PERSISIR_* — already pinned to named screens, no gap

exemption_policy: No gap is closed by an 'all pages except popup pages' style exemption. The one exclusion in the suite — modal occlusion on STATE_POPUP pages — predates this stage, is evidence-backed, and is pinned by four separate gates on count, shape name, page role and panel type.

validators_added_in_this_stage.reason: fixture F-601 passed silently; STATE_QUIZ_REVIEW was in no gate's population
validators_added_in_this_stage.population_anchor: model question set x STATE_QUIZ_REVIEW page
validators_added_in_this_stage.disclosed_weakness: SHARED_DERIVATION with the generator's controlled quiz content

replacements.source_of_expected_population: frozen model: 4 screens with screen_role COMPONENT_EXAMPLE_SELECTION, and every runtime state bound to them
replacements.mutation_fixture_required: F-101 / F-102 / F-103 / F-501 / F-502 (already built and detected)
replacements.implementation_stage_recommendation: IMPLEMENT_AT_NEXT_GENERATING_STAGE — no deck change required; the artifact already satisfies the widened population, so widening is a pure validator change

replacements.replacement_population_definition: req_screens = {learner_screen_id : the screen's BASE page classifies REQUIRED} ; population = every review page whose learner_screen_id is in req_screens
replacements.source_of_expected_population: frozen model: screens whose base page carries visual_requirement REQUIRED (12 screens), and every runtime state bound to them
replacements.mutation_fixture_required: F-502 (already built and detected via the selection-screen parity gate)
replacements.implementation_stage_recommendation: IMPLEMENT_AT_NEXT_GENERATING_STAGE for the selection and example-detail screens, which already satisfy it; the component-main portion is BLOCKED_ON_BARIAH as above.
replacements.note: visual_requirement is a per-STATE classification: the same screen is REQUIRED on its base page and NOT_REQUIRED on its specification popups. Selecting on it can never see the states it declassifies.
